Name: Em's Camels (SVE animals)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A new design and six colour options for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] camels
Including the camel, Marnie's shop icon, wool and yarn optional
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Camels CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a camel from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the six options
If you rather choose which type of bear you get, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar
[/url]
Alternatively, you can choose "Em's SVE Camels [b]Config"[/b]
This allows you to choose one type of camel for your farm with a config.json

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Xv26RvdB/Camel-Config.png[/img]

To change the default camel or wool and yarn colour:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the camel mod folder
Replace "Bactrian" with the name of the type you like
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KY9h6YBk/Camel-Compat.png[/img]

Looking through the assets folder, you can find two lama baby sprites
This is the start of making the camels compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34843]Camelus[/url]
It will take a bit of time to make all the sprites, but it's planned!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

﻿[i]Update 1.1 Compatible with livestock bazaar, two new types, animation improvements[/i]
